reviews.text:
Would recommend Andy’s 10000/10. Their team is incredibly talented and does a great job with each service. Pricing is super competitive and reasonable. Most importantly, they are very patient and gentle with each pet. My dog is quite finicky and anxious and they have always taken the time and care to make sure he stays safe and calm, I even once heard them singing to him to reassure him during a nail clipping, I recommend them to all my friends and will never take my dog elsewhere.

George is also so friendly and has taken the time on multiple occasions to recommend products to me (which were all great recs), always explains exactly what they can do and what my dog needs, and is just generally a really guy. He clearly cares about each animal and wants them to have the best experience possible.

I trust George and his team with my dog completely and that peace of mind means the world to me! Photos attached of his most recent cut, but they do a great job with nails, teeth, and everything else.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I’ve been bringing my cats to Andy’s Pet Grooming for the past few years, and I truly can’t recommend George and his team enough.

From the moment you walk in, George makes you feel like more than just a customer—he remembers your face, greets you like an old friend, and treats you like family. His kindness, sense of humor, and genuine compassion are just as impressive as his incredible knowledge and expertise with animals.

I recently brought in my oldest cat, whose fur had become severely matted. Rather than rushing through the appointment, George and his team took extra time and exceptional care to make sure she was as comfortable and stress-free as possible. They patiently shaved and carefully worked through the mats, and I could tell my cat’s well-being was their top priority every step of the way.

What meant the most to me was George’s compassion during a difficult time in my life. He was incredibly understanding of my financial hardships and worked with me so I could still get my cat the care she desperately needed. That level of kindness and empathy is something you don’t come across every day, and I’ll never forget it.

I trust George and his team completely with my pets, and that peace of mind is priceless. Whether you’re looking for grooming, boarding, or daycare, I wholeheartedly recommend Andy’s Pet Grooming. It’s a wonderful family-owned business that truly cares about both the animals and the people who love them.

Thank you, George and the entire team, for always treating my cats with such love and care. You’ve earned a customer for life. See you again in a couple months!
Best groomer in LA! The only groomer my dog loves to go to. Great value and service.

George gave excellent customer service, after when they were finished grooming our little Amigo who’s a Yorkie. He told me to if anything needs to be fixed on him lets us know and we will be more than happy to fix plus  pricing is while worth it. If your a first time customer, you will only be charged for the grooming

​I brought my cat into Andy’s Pet Shop in Eagle Rock to deal with some stubborn matted fur, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. They did an incredible job with his grooming and wash, and the lion cut looks absolutely adorable!
​The staff here is super friendly and you can tell they really care about the animals. Booking an appointment was a breeze, which I really appreciated. My cat looks great and is officially ready for the Spring weather! Highly recommend them if you're looking for a reliable, local groomer.

I have a long-haired Persian cat who needs frequent grooming. I've been all over the city with her and never found a groomer as kind, talented, or effective as Andy's. Most other groomers insist on giving her a lion cut and a full bath, which she doesn't really need—Andy's let me choose her hair length and dictate where I wanted to longer and shorter on her body. As a result, she's much happier and she looks a lot better, and going to the groomer isn't nearly as stressful as it's been in the past. They also didn't douse her in perfume like some groomers do, which both I and my cat really appreciate! Most importantly, they were very kind and sympathetic about her being in a cage around a lot of barking dogs, and took the time to separate her from them so she didn't get too stressed out.

I couldn't be happier with Andy's—highly recommend for you and your pet friends.

Hate to give bad reviews but had a really disappointing appointment today. People here are really friendly but they did a terrible job grooming my dog. When I got my dog back her fur was blown dry but was absolutely full of knots. I took her back, owner was apologetic and brushed her out and offered some treats which was nice. Unfortunately when I got her home she was STILL full of knots that I had to cut out. Mind you this is a 8lb toy sized dog so to have so many knots proportional to her size is a lot. I’d say if you get your dog groomed here check that they have been fully brushed out and don’t have knots, bc chances are this isn’t the first time since it happened to me twice.

They took great care of my pup Lola and were able to squeeze her in at last minute. They’re super kind, polite, and go above and beyond. Affordable pricing. Had a great experience. Will definitely be back!
We’ve taken our shy dachshund here many times and couldn’t recommend Andy’s more! Not only do they have quick service but our baby always looks fantastic afterwards.
Andy’s Pet Grooming located in Eagle Rock and Colorado is highly recommended they have excellent job for dog and very accommodating so you try their services. That’s  why I keep coming back  .
Staff was great but you can probably get better price deals elsewhere. I actually know of a few that charge half of what this place charges.
First time going here with one of my moms dogs and one of mine and they did an AMAZING job. My dog looks 5 years younger; so shiny and soft! We will be back. 🤍 …

I had a great experience with my dog at Andy's grooming. My dog is a rescue and a scared little boy and he was great with him. You always know its a good sign when a groomer is very excited to meet your dog and loves dogs, and you can tell. I am happy to have finally found my new dog groomer.
Love this place! My Covid dog has been so nervous at the groomer in the past. The staff here are so thoughtful and handle him with care every time!

The best in town!
George is amazing!
Highly recommended.
Love this place
This is such a fantastic groomer! George was lovely and so helpful with my newly adopted cat, who loved his first grooming. I will absolutely be back regularly.

I took my puppy grooming here ! Very professional and very friendly with our dog ! Will definitely come
Back again!
Andy did such an incredible job with my golden pup Althea. She came back soo happy, so clean cut and sooo soft feeling. Pricing was very fair and service was prompt. 110% coming back.
Did exactly what I asked for after a great convo with the incredibly nice owner. Huge recommend!
I frequently utilize this service to transport my puppy, and I must say, it is excellent. The owner is exceptionally astute and a pleasure to interact with. He performs his duties admirably.

First time coming here and I have to say they are amazing. My dog Leeloo has anxiety and very timid with people however they did an amazing job and she looks so good. Very affordable and so sweet with my Leeloo. I am definitely coming back here.
Very kind owner , we could tell he really enjoys working with animals. He took care of our anxious ragdoll kitty and gave him a great trim and wash. It's been 4 weeks and he's still super soft!
Amazing service.  They took our dog last second and did a great job

This is the third visit for all four of my cats, and we love the service! They smell so nice after their visit. They are very professional, friendly, and welcoming. Definitely, going to keep coming back.
Very friendly and professional, they cut according to the need of the breed.
Andy’s has been an incredible experience! My dog Mochi, a labradoodle visits every 3 weeks. The team is always warm, caring and highly consistent. I’m a fan and happy to recommend.

What can I say George and his team treat my nervous anxiety ridden pouch like their own!! My dog loves George!  They care deeply that she's ok while she's being groomed and that we both leave happy.  Honestly we've been to many groomers once we found Andy's we never left.  My dog had past trauma from former groomers.  It's such a relief knowing she's in such loving hands.  She is a long haired dog and needs to be groomed frequently. She always comes out looking and smelling amazing. We have been loyal customers for years and remain so. Thank you George

I take both my dogs here
One of my dog is not very nice
But Andy’s pet grooming making my life easier
Thank you for your professionalism
I will recommend everyone to go
George and company took good care of our pup- He came out clean,handsome, and happy! We definitely recommend.
I’ve been confidently bringing my Samoyed here for two years now. Stellar work by caring and thoughtful staff. The owner George is great.

Today was my first visit and I'm glad I went, Jorge is very helpful and kind. I took both of my dogs in and they handled them with care! I will be coming back often because ny dogs looked great and felt soft..
We had an excellent experience! He was thorough, knowledgeable, and clearly cared about our dog’s well-being. We would absolutely bring our dog back without hesitation. Highly recommend!

I’ve been taking my dogs to Andy’s Grooming for two years now, and they are truly the best pet groomers I’ve ever found. They treat my dogs like family, with so much care and love. I have a Boston Terrier and a Husky, and every time they come home, they smell amazing and have beautifully shiny coats. The customer service is outstanding—they’re always on time, professional, and super flexible whenever I need a last-minute bath or appointment. I can’t recommend them enough!
Great service ! My dog loves all gen staff!
Great service and my dog hasn’t had issues as I did with previous groomer. Definitely recommend. My dog was really matted o had to shave him
It’s a good store with good service.

We decided to try another groomer today and we’re very happy with our experience. The office staff was very helpful and welcoming. Our dog is always a bit anxious when we take her to the groomers, but when we picked her up not only did she look adorable, but she was happy and relaxed 😃  We will definitely be returning! …
We’ve been coming to Andy’s for over a year and are so happy with their service. They’re kind, efficient and honest. Love supporting this local business!
The best in town!
I’m very happy with the service, come to this place you’re gonna love it

George was great help over the phone while I was looking for a great place to bring my pup very personal . Informative . Maureen at the front desk was very kind and supportive . Over all very happy with our first visit and will be coming here again .
Great service, very friendly, overall a very good experience. Took care of my English bulldog no problem.
Very friendly place, treated our dog really well! Solid communication. Got a wash and nail clipping, dog was super clean after! Highly recommend!
Love this place. Very friendly and professional.  I get my dog's nails done here regularly.

I’ve been bringing my pets here for years and for me they’re the best around.  My sweet dog who’s no longer with us was always groomed so well, with different styles and lengths as the season changed.  Now that my cat is much older he needs help so we’re there just as often for bathing and grooming.  I don’t know how but they always make him look great.  The new owner George is so great and gives me a warm greeting and a good chuckle every time I’m in there!
100% recommend this place! Everyone is super nice, great pricing, and a great job! Happy customer!
We love how much G adores & care for the dogs
We love Andy's. They always do a great job with my baby!!! We love ageorge, too- so funny and helpful.
Love Andy’s! They do such a great job and are very kind and accommodating. I love that the cut is consistent and they really try to adjust per your requests. This is our spot!
Excellent job, great service and excellent customer service!!!! Instructions well listened, for sure coming back to get my son Ziggy groomed again
Glad to have them doing Toby's grooming again. They're great at understanding the right cut for him.

Been taking my yorkie here for years then I moved to Pasadena and went to that location a few times but now make the longer trip back to Eagle Rock because they’re very friendly and the haircut is always perfect. Definitely recommend giving them a try.
Love this shop. My favorite groomer in LA my chihuahua is always so nervous and they take such good care of her. 10/10
Love the customer help ! Was so patient and kind with my dog ! I love it here ! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND ❤️

We've been bringing our dog, Loki, to George for a few years now and I'm always impressed with his attention to detail. He makes sure that every note and special request is followed exactly -- requests like "avoiding using razor on Loki's belly" and "be extra careful with her ears". It's clear he truly cares about both the pets and their owners. Highly recommended if you're looking for a groomer who listens, delivers, and also great to have conversations with!

Tried Andy’s Pet Grooming for the first time today and had a great experience! George was super helpful and made sure my dog got exactly what she needed. You can tell they really care about the pets they work with. Highly recommend!

The team here is really attentive & thorough! Although our big shepherd doesn't "love" going to the groomers, he no longer seems traumatized afterwards--which was what other places used to do to him. George & crew make our boy look amazing & he never panics when we arrive (unlike at other places). We have renewed our package multiple times & will continue to do so.
Fantastic staff, George is the man. We’ve been taking our little dog Gnocchi here for years and would recommend his shop to everyone.
First time bring my dog to a groomer. They did an amazing job , will definitely come again!(:

Excellent job!! Ezri came back looking better than ever with a great big grin on her face. She got the bath, nail trim, and gland expression treatment (full spa treatment) and looks great! I will be back, thank you again!! 😊 …

If you need a place for your fur babies this is the one! Great customer service and a trustworthy place for the pups! Highly recommend Andys Pet Grooming, George was amazing! Thank you for never disappointing:)
Top notch. Tried most of the other places in the area and this place is the best
George is super friendly, professional and they do a great job.  My dog who has a lot of anxiety does great with them
I love this place. George is great, my dog Spencer is a nervous guy and they’re always so great with him. Get a package deal, it makes everything easier.
Really great looking cut for my dog. They got the teddy bear face look really well. Also they are very friendly and welcoming to both me and my dog
This was Ollie’s first time and they did such a great job. Staff is very welcoming and patient. Will definitely be coming back!
My cat’s coat looks fresh and new. She was very calm when I picked her up, which told me she was handled with care. The staff was and kind and communicative. This is definitely our new go-to groomer.
Always great service, easy to get an appointment and friendly groomers

I had the best experience at Andy’s grooming. It was our first visit. George was able to squeeze my pup in for a bath and did a phenomenal job! I really appreciate his professionalism and attention to detail. My pup looks great. We will definitely come back when he’s ready for a grooming!

Best grooming place ! Let me start off with the staff: George (owner) is awesome…super welcoming and fantastic with dogs. Carmen is the best groomer – she listens carefully and does exactly what I ask, making sure my dogs look perfect every time. George mom is also incredibly sweet.

The shop itself is packed with food, treats, clothes, and other cute items. But what I love most is how they treat my babies. I bring in all four of my dogs and they always come out looking beautiful. Highly recommend this place !

We’ve been taking our Golden Doodle to George for a while now and his crew consistently does a great job and our dog seems to like going there. She always receives a nice trim and comes back clean and beautiful. If you’re looking for a good groomer around this area, feel free to give them a try.

We love George and his crew, including his mom Marine! Our "burritos" come back perfectly groomed, soft, fluffy and never with a mat. That's a big deal because our Bolonki have super fine hair and their hair mats extremely easily! Both George and Marine are so friendly, please go meet them. You won't be disappointed!
Great groomer and service.

I highly recommend Andy's pet grooming, they took care of my two cats with grooming and nail trimming. George was super knowledgeable and helpful. I’ve tried other places and the service here was great. They answered my questions, were professional, and took great care of my pets. Thank you!
They do a great jog with our Aussie. She may not like it but the staff is always sweet and gentle with her. She comes back beautiful every time and gets a treat.

These guys really know dogs. I took my 7 month old wheaten-lab mix here for his first grooming appointment ever and it couldn’t have gone better. He came away looking, smelling and feeling great. George was a pleasure to work with and he showed me pictures of his handsome chocolate pitbull. Highly recommend for anyone who wants a fun and professional experience with a groomer!
What an amazing place and service. I can recommend this pet grooming place to anyone 😍 …
Awesome job!  First time for my dog.  George was very patient.
Andy’s Pet Grooming was amazing!! They took my pup same day and did a wonderful job. She looks gorgeous. George was incredibly nice and even threw in some beef jerky on the house. Highly recommend!

The service was great.  We brought our dog in and they finished in 15 minutes!!! They are very efficient and professional as well. I will definitely be back for future services. I would highly recommend their services to anyone.
My dog was very well taken care of and the staff was so kind!
Amazing customer service Jorge and the groomer was amazing and nala loved it 🥰 …
Happy Girl after her grooming session!!! She smelled really good and looks amazing!!! Will be coming back
Always do a great job, MY dogs look amazing!  I know when I need to leave  them at Day care their is never problem , they  don't even over charge. Great PLACE!

We had a really great experience here! It was easy to get in with staff being very friendly and accommodating . The grooming was great and our dog seemed super happy . We will definitely be going back!
This place actually cares and takes care of dogs with care. The top spot and service on top
Friendly and i really recommended

Ive been taking Odie here for years and they always do a great job.  Odie always comes home well groomed and smelling wonderfully.   Odie sheds so much and after he comes home from Andys he sheds a lot less.  Great service great people!  Will always be a continuing customer.
